entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: About that virtual currency[n]investment scammer... She's[n]turned herself in.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Most of the money she swindled[n]was apparently untouched in her[n]accounts.

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: I hope we can keep helping[n]people in need like this.

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So that scam really was too good to[n]be true. We'd better not fall for any[n]of those ourselves!
